items.Sentence: Screened effluent is discharged to one of two parallel facultative lagoons.
The WWTF features a headworks, dual facultative lagoon system operated in parallel, and two disposal ponds. Each lagoon contains a 5-horsepower aerator.
The resulting volume for one disposal pond at the operating depth of 2.7 feet is 18.2 acre-feet, which provides about 36.4 acre-feet of total storage.
Treated effluent from the lagoons discharges to a splitter box enabling the return of treated effluent to the lagoons, recirculation via the lift station, or discharge to one of two disposal ponds.
